## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated (test-first where it made sense)
- [ ] `openapi/payments-api.yaml` updated if the HTTP contract changed (and the change is backwards compatible)
- [ ] Logs, metrics and traces considered for new code paths
- [ ] Security / data-handling implications considered (no secrets or PII in logs)
- [ ] Docs / ADR updated if a decision changed
- [ ] If AI-assisted: I read, understood and validated the output (see docs/ai-assisted-engineering.md)
